name: hive_clx
description: Honeycomb Biotechnologies HIVE CLX data requiring BeeNet or equivalent vendor-specific preprocessing.

halt_guidance.blocker: HIVE CLX barcode decoding and correction require the matching Honeycomb chemistry and BeeNetPLUS resources; these cannot be reconstructed reliably from generic FASTQ structure alone.
required_inputs: HIVE CLX kit/chemistry version and the matching BeeNetPLUS analysis configuration
Reference genome and annotation compatible with the intended comparison
next_steps: Confirm the HIVE CLX kit version from the methods or depositor metadata.
Run the downloaded FASTQs through BeeNetPLUS with the matching reference.
Archive the BeeNetPLUS configuration and exported count matrix or BAM with the UniScFlow halt marker.

recommended_workflows.name: BeeNetPLUS
recommended_workflows.role: Honeycomb-supported HIVE CLX preprocessing and quantification

halt_guidance.resume: Use the BeeNetPLUS matrix/BAM as the downstream endpoint; UniScFlow does not generate a generic HIVE CLX mapper command.
